title: Setup [pt2]
description:
Setups almost done! Now, you need to do two things: grab the course starter files, and get the lessons!

---
### Getting the starter files
Run this command:
```bash
# get the files .zip
curl -L https://github.com/Youg-Otricked/lhc-learn-linux-starter/archive/refs/heads/main.zip -o ~/linux-starter.zip
# unzip the files
unzip ~/linux-starter.zip -d ~
# move the files out of the archive
mv ~/lhc-learn-linux-starter-main ~/linux-start-assets
# delete zip
rm ~/linux-starter.zip
```

---
### Installing the course
Just run `lhc upgrade`.

---
## Using the CLI
To see a list of commands, run `lhc help`. However, you wont need almost any of those commands right now, for now, to run a lesson you use `lhc run <HASH>` and to submit it, `lhc run <HASH> -s`. Run has less feedback but you won't fail the lesson on fail and submit has more feedback but a higher risk.
To change to the linux course, run `lhc ch-course "learn-linux"`. To change courses you run `lhc ch-course "<coursename>"`--
Just run the run/submit command.
